name: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
when_to_use: Metric variables correlated with one another; reduces dimensionality without assuming a theoretical latent structure; adequacy checked by KMO and Bartlett's test of sphericity before extracting components.

expected_input.question: What is the dimensionality reduction that preserves variance?

plain_explanation.purpose: Summarizes many correlated columns into a few 'overall scores', losing as little information as possible.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When there are many measures that say almost the same thing and you want to trim down or draw everything on a 2D chart.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A table with several numeric columns correlated with each other; at least a few dozen rows.
plain_explanation.example: Reduce 20 social indicators of each city to 2 axes to plot on a position map.
plain_explanation.diagram: 20 columns  ->  [PCA]  ->  2 axes (score 1, score 2) + how much each axis explains
